}}{{TournamentPageStart|twitchid=lec|toclimit=2|text=The '''LEC 2024 Season Finals''' is the culmination of the LEC 2024 season. It is the second season finals following the changed format. The top 6 teams from across the season will fight for the championship in a double elimination bracket and qualification to [[2024 Season World Championship|Worlds 2024]]. }}

==Overview==
=== Format ===
* 6 teams participate
** [[LEC/2024 Season/Winter Playoffs|Winter]] and [[LEC/2024 Season/Spring Playoffs|Spring]] Champions, and the top 3 [[LEC/2024 Season/Summer Playoffs|Summer]] Split Teams
** The Teams with the most [[LEC/2024 Season/Championship Points|Championship Points]], until all six slots are filled
* Double elimination bracket
* Matches are best of five
* Top 2 teams qualify for the [[2024 Season World Championship]]
